assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: Population assertion fails when the fixture ceases to contain 240 live pointers; elapsed bound fails when the full-plan parse cost is restored (recorded base 101.47921030689031 seconds); phase-presence assertion fails if requests disappear; positive release duration fails if that stage is skipped/unrecorded; empty launched assertion fails on an unexpected launch with the zero-slot lane.
assertion_review.limit: Phase presence alone does not prove correct release; timing and no-launch assertions do not measure decisions with available slots.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: Cross-arm decisions/phases fail if reuse differs from another head sweep; both independent phase assertions fail if all derived waits are dropped or neither no-wait request is released.
assertion_review.independence: The fixed fixture partition is independent of the returned phase map, so the added expected-phase assertions are not self-comparisons.
assertion_review.limit: Both arms still share the optimized implementation; restoring a parser defect outside this fixture can leave both green.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: ran assertion fails if release is throttled; queued assertion fails if the original no-wait request is not released; final awaiting-upstream assertion fails if document invalidation is removed so a between-stage edit remains queued.
assertion_review.limit: The edit happens after the snapshot, so moving an edit inside the sweep does not exercise the same assertion path.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: Metadata-vs-parsed equality fails if dependency edges differ from the independent full HTML parser; checked-count fails if the cohort is not visited; explicit nonempty read fails if a tested long-head/escaped dependency is dropped.
assertion_review.limit: No whitespace-around-equals or uppercase semantic-attribute variant is included.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: Skipped-release assertion fails if the release tick unexpectedly runs; positive wait-read assertion fails on uniform-zero measured reads; reconciliation fails when named times differ beyond 5 percent/one recorded millisecond; heaviest-read omission assertion fails if the check accepts a materially incomplete receipt.
assertion_review.independence: The negative receipt is constructed by removing an observed read while retaining the independently recorded stage duration; no assertion added by this node compares a returned value only with the same value supplied as input.

deferred_live_measurement: Source manifest evidence_inputs explicitly defers ten consecutive post-landing live receipts; this review does not claim the live-service portion of section s10 is satisfied.

findings.text: blocking: A short valid document containing <meta name = "plan-depends-on" content = "upstream"> loses its whole-plan waits: parse_meta uses _NAME_RE/_CONTENT_RE requiring name= and content= without intervening whitespace, and this function interprets that reader's miss as authoritative absence for files at most 16384 bytes; the previous read_state_file path uses the HTML parser and retains the dependency, so the optimized admission path can release a request before its upstream lands.

blocking: The case-sensitive data-reckon substring check treats a valid body authored with DATA-RECKON="decisions" or DATA-RECKON="followups" as body-free and returns empty decision/followup lists; BeautifulSoup's html.parser normalizes HTML attribute names, and the previous _read_readiness_state/metadata_index.readiness_from_state path retains those records, so authored holds can disappear from readiness.

blocking: The document fingerprint is captured only after advance_waiting_requests has finished; if a plan is edited after its request was judged but before this fingerprint is taken, the stale verdict is stamped with the edited document's identity and selection.admit_once accepts it as current, skipping the second sweep that previously read the new waits; snapshot before the sweep as well and make reuse conditional on stability through the read, with a regression that edits inside the sweep rather than after _release_tick returns.

blocking: Both equivalence arms execute the optimized head code and force zero worker slots through _reference_pass; independent phase expectations catch dropped waits but cannot establish the declared equality of base/head launch and release decisions, and the recorded base negative control ends its other cases in unsupported-argument/missing-helper errors rather than producing a comparable base decision result; retain decision results from the actual base and head on the same reset home, including a launchable nonzero-slot case.
